name: Perfume of Bewitching

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 DMG (personal build); check every number against the book.

powers.name: Dab it on
powers.text: For 1 hour, you have Advantage on Charisma checks made to influence Humanoids of CR 1 or lower.

summary: For an hour, Advantage on Charisma checks to sway ordinary folk.
text: The tiny vial holds a single dose. Dabbing it on yourself takes an action, and for the next 1 hour you have Advantage on every Charisma check aimed at a Humanoid whose Challenge Rating is 1 or lower. Creatures swayed by the scent never realise magic influenced them.
